name: mirage
text: It isn't switched off. Your master switch is on, and nothing is paused or stopped. The warning is a wrong label for the restart I started at 17:05, so that's my fault. For about 14 minutes there was no engine heartbeat, and the app described that gap as 'switched off'. The new engine started about 3 minutes ago and its list is fresh, so pull to refresh. I'm fixing the wording so a restart reads 'restarting', not 'switched off'. I won't restart the engine again unless I have to.
